credits.title: Credits
credits.heading: Credits & Info
credits.about.what_body: hailsDotGO is a fan-made toolkit for Pokémon GO players: raid counters, DPS calculations, PvP IV rankings, a full shiny Pokémon dex, a personal shiny collection tracker, a Trainer Directory, and a live Raid Finder for coordinating remote raids with other players.
credits.about.disclaimer: The site is not affiliated with Niantic, The Pokémon Company, or Nintendo.
credits.about.source_pogoapi: Pokémon stats, moves, type effectiveness, shiny availability, CP multipliers
credits.about.source_pokeminers: mined costume art for the shiny dex, served from our own cache
credits.about.source_masterfile: costume and form names behind the costume picker
credits.about.source_dittobase: cross-checking costume names and release events
credits.about.source_pokeapi: Pokémon sprites, Pokédex flavor text, genus, legendary/mythical flags, in-game cries, and official localized Pokémon names
credits.about.source_openmeteo: current weather data used to determine Pokémon GO weather boosts
credits.about.source_scrapedduck: current and upcoming event data, full event details, and event images, from LeekDuck
credits.about.source_showdown: trainer class and named character sprites for the Classic avatar set
credits.about.source_dreamstone: GBA-style trainer sprites for the Dreamstone avatar set
credits.about.source_pex: FRLG-style trainer sprites for the pokeemerald-expansion avatar set
credits.about.source_platinum: native Gen 4 Diamond/Pearl/Platinum trainer sprites for the Platinum avatar set
credits.api.public_body: The following endpoints are publicly accessible and return game data as JSON. Two limits apply per IP: a per-endpoint request rate limit and an aggregate bandwidth cap across all endpoints in this table combined.
credits.api.data_desc: All game data in one payload (Pokémon, moves, raids, shinies, type chart, CP multipliers)
credits.api.maxbattles_desc: Current Max Battle bosses by tier
credits.api.events_desc: Current and upcoming events (LeekDuck via ScrapedDuck)
credits.api.event_detail_desc: Full details for one event (sanitized HTML from LeekDuck)
credits.api.bw_note: Bandwidth limit: 15 MB total across all endpoints per 5-minute window. Exceeding this triggers a 30-minute block.
credits.api.cache_note2: Game data refreshes every 6 hours; events every 30 minutes; raid bosses every 4 hours on Mountain Time.
credits.api.community_body: These endpoints return per-user profile data. No rate limit applies, but profile-scoped endpoints respect privacy settings and return an empty result rather than an error when data is not visible.
credits.api.awards_desc: Full awards catalog with names, descriptions, and icons
credits.api.awards_of_desc: Awards earned by a specific user
credits.api.shinies_of_desc: A user's public shiny collection; empty array if their profile is private or they have hidden their collection in Settings
credits.api.private_body: The private API is intended for trusted server-side consumers. It exposes the same data as the public API with no rate limiting, but requires an account with API access granted by the site superadmin.
credits.api.private_maxbattles_desc: Current Max Battle bosses (same as public)
credits.api.private_refresh_desc: Force an immediate refresh of all cached game data (rate-limited to 2 per 10 minutes globally)
credits.api.private_auth: Authentication uses your session cookie. Contact the site operator if you need access.
credits.api.your_access_body: Your account has been granted access to the private API. The private endpoints mirror the public API but carry no rate limit and are intended for trusted server-side use.
credits.api.your_access_cookie_note: Include the hgo_session cookie in each request. Find its value in your browser's developer tools: Application → Cookies → pogo.hails.app.
credits.api.your_access_warning: Keep your session token private. If you believe it has been exposed, log out and back in to generate a new one.
credits.api.note_rate_limit: Exceeding the public rate limit returns
credits.api.note_unofficial: This is an unofficial fan-made toolkit; endpoints may change without notice.
credits.changelog.intro: A running log of updates and improvements.
